messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error building package BOOM preventing deployment
parts:
Looks like Boom requires g++ 4.9.x, and we only have 4.8.x available.

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/36034316/r-package-boom-fails-to-install-on-ubuntu-linux

As such, I don't think we have a short term solution for making it available. The time frame for moving to Xenial, which has g++ 5.3.x, has not been determined yet. We will talk about what getting 4.9.x onto Trusty might take.

Sorry I don't have better news.

On Wednesday, 18 May 2016 19:18:46 UTC+2, Joshua Spiewak wrote:

Looks like Boom requires g++ 4.9.x, and we only have 4.8.x available.

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/36034316/r-package-boom-fails-to-install-on-ubuntu-linux

As such, I don't think we have a short term solution for making it available. The time frame for moving to Xenial, which has g++ 5.3.x, has not been determined yet. We will talk about what getting 4.9.x onto Trusty might take.

Sorry I don't have better news.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error building package BOOM preventing deployment
parts: It has taken some time, but today's update of the base system to Xenial appears to have resolved this.
On Wednesday, May 18, 2016 at 1:18:46 PM UTC-4, Joshua Spiewak wrote:

Looks like Boom requires g++ 4.9.x, and we only have 4.8.x available.

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/36034316/r-package-boom-fails-to-install-on-ubuntu-linux

As such, I don't think we have a short term solution for making it available. The time frame for moving to Xenial, which has g++ 5.3.x, has not been determined yet. We will talk about what getting 4.9.x onto Trusty might take.

Sorry I don't have better news.
